hard_rules: The problem names who bears it and an observable condition with a metric, a baseline figure and an evidence record.
The outcome sought has a metric, a target figure and a date.
The causal chain has at least one link, and every link carries evidence records that exist.
The intervention point names one causal link that exists in the chain.

The prime commercial opportunity names a customer, that customer's observable condition, the core functionality, the payer, the payer's relationship to the people who bear the problem, and an evidence record for willingness to pay.
The outcome link states the mechanism, the scale assumption, a numeric contribution to the target, and the arithmetic, and carries evidence records that exist.
Every requirement names the causal link it acts on, and that link exists.
Every requirement has exactly one stated bottleneck and intervention.
Every requirement traces to one or more existing components and evidence records.
Every evidence record is sourced or has a named falsification test.
FMOS equals (price_ceiling - cost_floor) / cost_floor and is at least 25%.
No open item may be represented as resolved.
